recent.text: Re: a 4yr contract for Bauers. He'll enter 2027 with 6.084 of service time (6 yrs, 84 days). That means a 4yr deal will get him to the 10yr mark by early-July in that final year. That would unlock the full pension (~$300k per year) + full medical. Gotta stay healthy first.

recent.text: The Red Sox have made three major additions in each of the last two offseason The only one who wasn’t an All-Star the following season was Sonny Gray, who just finished 5th in Cy Young voting Spare with the “bargain shopping” narrative
recent.author: Daniel Fox
recent.quoted_text: Nothing against Jake Bauers. Love his comeback story. If the Red Sox had earned our trust by fixing roster holes, I’d welcome him. But this front office keeps bargain shopping instead of addressing obvious needs. Arozarena and Suzuki bring proven right-handed power.
